agent_protocol.subagent_brief: Each task object describes one self-contained unit of work. Open the plan_file at the heading named in 'plan_section_heading' and follow every step in that section literally — file contents, exact commands, and commit message are all spelled out there. Use the file contents shown in the plan verbatim. Do not deviate unless you hit a typing or runtime error that must be fixed; if you do, document the deviation in your completion report.
agent_protocol.tdd_pattern: Tasks that include test files follow strict TDD: (1) write the failing test, (2) run the test to verify it fails with the expected message, (3) write the minimal implementation, (4) run the test to verify it passes, (5) commit. Do not write the implementation before seeing the test fail.
agent_protocol.completion_criteria: A task is complete only when every entry in 'verification_commands' exits 0 with the expected output AND the commit described in 'commit' has been created. Report the actual test counts and command outputs in your completion message.
do_not: Do not skip the 'verify it fails' step — it confirms the test is exercising new code, not passing accidentally.
Do not amend or rewrite earlier commits.
Do not run --no-verify or skip hooks.
Do not add features beyond what the task requires.

tasks.name: agentStage factory + AgentRunner interface
tasks.summary: Implement agentStage<T>(cfg, runner) that turns a Claude SDK call into a Stage. AgentRunner is the injectable boundary: run<T>({ prompt, schema, tools?, model? }) -> Promise<T>. Stage builds the prompt, calls runner.run, applies the typed output to PipelineState via cfg.applyOutput. Optional canRun, defaults to always-true.

tasks.name: revisionLoop factory
tasks.summary: Implement revisionLoop({ name, producer, reviewer, maxAttempts, isApproved, onExhausted? }) — a composite Stage. Internally loops producer.execute then reviewer.execute up to maxAttempts. Exits on first isApproved(state) == true. On exhaustion calls onExhausted (if provided) and returns. Honours abortFlag between attempts.

creates.purpose: revisionLoop factory + RevisionLoopConfig
revisionLoop spec — 6 tests: approve-first-pass, loops until approve, onExhausted-called-when-exhausted, returns-latest-state-without-onExhausted, abort breaks loop, exposes name

tasks.name: checkpoint factory
tasks.summary: Implement checkpoint({ name, detect, rerunCommand?, timeoutHours? }) — a Stage whose execute calls detect(state, ctx). If detect returns true, pass through. If false, set state.currentStage = cfg.name and throw PipelinePauseError so the orchestrator persists and exits cleanly.

creates.purpose: checkpoint factory + CheckpointConfig
checkpoint spec — 4 tests: pass-through on true, throws PipelinePauseError + pins currentStage on false, exposes name and default canRun, forwards state and context to detect

commit.message: feat(pipeline): add checkpoint factory with PipelinePauseError
